title: SEAM run manifest
description: Implements blueprint §5.2 plus the Platform-A fields of implementation spec §6.1. Every experimental run emits one of these. No manifest, no data. The union of the two field sets is deliberate: see AMENDMENTS.md AM-003 for the fields blueprint §5.2 requires that spec §6.1 omits — those are present here as optional and nullable so a blueprint requirement is never silently dropped.

run_id.description: uuid4. The identifier every emitted number must trace back to (spec §9.2).

spec_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped only alongside this file and an AMENDMENTS.md entry.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 with explicit offset. For cross-signal correlation only — durations use perf_counter_ns (spec §3.5).

git_sha.description: Full 40-hex commit of the harness that produced this run. Never null: an unknown git state is a hard failure, not a null field.

git_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes. When true, git_sha does NOT describe the code that ran.

allow_dirty.description: True if --allow-dirty was passed. Recorded per spec §7/M1 so a non-reproducible run can never look reproducible. Must be true whenever git_dirty is true (enforced by the conditional below).

git_dirty_files.description: git status --porcelain lines when dirty. States what was uncommitted, not merely that something was.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the fully resolved config, canonically serialised.

config_sources.description: Repository-relative config paths that produced config_hash, in load order.

elevated.description: Whether the process ran with Administrator rights. RAPL MSR access (spec §3.1 S2) requires it.

p_cpus.description: Logical CPUs measured to be P-cores. Null until verified — never a plausible guess (AMENDMENTS.md AM-008).

verified.description: True only if seam.topology measured the split empirically (spec §4).

provenance_artifacts.description: Probe artifacts this run relied on, hashed at emit time (blueprint AF-002). Hashes are computed from bytes on disk, never transcribed.

microcode.description: Blueprint §5.2 requires this; spec §6.1 omits it. Nullable until captured. See AM-003.

power_cap_w.description: Blueprint §5.2. Required to identify an M5 power-cap sweep cell (15/25/55 W).

power_state.description: Quiescence controls from spec §3.2 item 1. Every one is logged so a condition cannot drift silently.

thermal.description: Constants are null until M2.3 determines and freezes them (blueprint §5.4). The illustrative values in spec §6.1 are schema examples, not defaults — see AMENDMENTS.md AM-006.

excluded.description: True if throttle residency exceeded the threshold (blueprint §5.4 item 5). Excluded runs stay in raw/ and are counted in the throttling table — never deleted.

ambient_c_start.description: Blueprint §5.2 wants both endpoints so ambient drift within a run is detectable; spec §6.1 collapses them to one. See AM-003.

pkg_temp_series_path.description: Blueprint §5.4 item 4 mandates a ≥1 Hz temperature series.

target.description: Four local targets plus cloud. No dGPU on this platform.

cloud.description: Blueprint §5.2 models.cloud. Absent from spec §6.1, but target may be 'cloud' and M3.2/M6 mandate pinned dated snapshots plus versioned pricing. Becomes required for cloud runs at M3 — see AM-003.

npu_config.description: openvino#34617 requires both to be set explicitly; never rely on defaults (spec §5.2).

kind.description: 'topology_verify' is the §4 core-classification run. It is a distinct kind rather than a 'microbench' because it is the one workload whose REFUSAL is itself the result: a verification that does not establish the mapping still emits a manifest so its per-CPU scores are citable (AMENDMENTS.md AM-010, AUDIT_LOG.md AF-006).

policy.description: Blueprint §5.2. The partition policy under test — the independent variable for H2/H3. Absent from spec §6.1; see AM-003.

network.description: Blueprint §5.2 / §9.3. Cloud latency is uninterpretable without it. Absent from spec §6.1; see AM-003.

condition_label.description: The true condition. WRITTEN HERE BUT NEVER READ BY ANALYSIS. Analysis consumes blinded_label only (spec §8, blueprint §5); a separate explicit unblind step joins them.

blinded_label.description: The only label analysis code may consume.

token_ledger_path.description: Blueprint §5.2 / M3.2 mandates a token and cost ledger. Absent from spec §6.1; see AM-003.

events_path.description: JSON-lines structured log for this run (spec §8).

self_check.description: Harness self-check verdict. A 'fail' is one of only three grounds for discarding a run (blueprint §5.3).

raw_sha256.description: Tree hash over the run's data outputs, excluding manifest.json (a hash cannot cover the file containing it) and events.ndjson (which grows as this manifest is emitted). The seal marker separately records a hash covering the whole run, which is what verify_sealed() checks.

allOf.description: A dirty tree is only permissible when it was explicitly allowed. This makes it structurally impossible to emit a manifest that hides a non-reproducible run.
A run claiming a verified topology must name the CPUs it verified.

A cpu-p or cpu-lpe run is meaningless without a verified core mapping. The single exemption is the run that PRODUCES the mapping: a 'topology_verify' workload cannot assert a verified topology as a precondition of establishing one, and when it refuses it must still be able to record that refusal (AMENDMENTS.md AM-010). The exemption is keyed on workload.kind, not on target, so no measurement workload can escape the precondition.

A topology_verify run that did not establish the mapping must say so in its verdict. Without this, the AF-006 fix would create a new hazard: a manifest that records a refusal while reporting self_check 'pass', which would read as a successful verification.
